profile.headline: Consultant (Software Engineer 3) at Daugherty Business Solutions
profile.summary: Currently, I work remotely as a consultant in software engineering at Daugherty Business Solutions. I am a June 2018 graduate from the University of California - Santa Barbara with a Bachelor's in Computer Science. I love technology of all types, but my real passion is for programming. The languages I'm most familiar with are Ruby, C++, and Java; however, I'm constantly striving to learn more languages and frameworks.

positions.title: Consultant (Software Engineer 3)
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and deployed Spring Boot applications from the ground-up including CI/CD pipelines, utilizing Git, Jenkins, Forge, and Pivotal Cloud Foundry
Automated previously manually done processes, saving teams significant time and effort
Maintained multiple applications and migrated legacy applications to newer frameworks and implementations
Assisted with onboarding new developers and fellow coworkers with troubleshooting, setup, and guidance for tasks

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented back-end ReSTful API endpoints in Java with SQL databases
Enhanced existing software in Java, C#, and CCL based on requirements
Tested code through unit (JUnit, etc), integration (Cucumber, etc), and functional testing

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.description:
Practiced development on enterprise software solutions using Java, Spring, and Hibernate
Created RESTful web services using HTML, CSS, Angular, and Spring MVC
Trained on Python scripting and SQL/MongoDB databases

positions.title: Computer Support Tech
positions.description:
Resolved technical issues for Life Sciences and Chemistry faculty and students
Documented tickets and technical issues
Networked machines and created user accounts

positions.title: Network Technician
positions.description:
Automated configuration, testing, and deployment of networking equipment using Ruby
Maintained and updated scripts created by previous employees
Supported customers and staff in troubleshooting connection issues

positions.title: Tech Intern
positions.description:
Imaged new or faulty computers using Acronis
Assisted faculty with technical issues

projects.title: Size Squared
projects.description: A game for iOS and Android created at MHacks IV using Cocos2D-iPhone in Objective-C. This is currently being rebuilt using Unity and C#

projects.title: First of Them
projects.description: In 24 hours our team created this simple game for the Pebble SmartWatch at YCHacks in C.
